messages:
sophia: FYI escalation from ACME — they reported p99 jumping to ~4s after a ~30s burst. Customer uses Dedicated pool `acme-dedicated-1`. They saw scale-up delays and a handful of 503s. Repro: 200 concurrent infer calls with API key `sk-acme-XX` -> p95 ~300ms, p99 ~4s.

alex: ack, creating incident and paging SRE. @mohit can you grab provisioning logs for `acme-dedicated-1`? any recent policy changes?

ci-bot: Incident INC-2026-45 created (priority: P1) — oncall notified.

mohit: looking. quick read: orchestrator shows a backlog at attach phase, several cold GPU starts queued. Scale decision happened but attach completed ~40–50s after decision. I also see a couple of auth 401s around the time window (likely stale tokens), but majority are attach/warmup delays.

sophia: adding customer repro snippet and logs:
```
POST /v1/generate 100x concurrent
response p99: 3.9s
logs acme-dedicated-1 attach: start 12:10:11 -> handshake 12:10:58 -> ready 12:11:02
errors: 401 x3, 503 x7 during 12:10-12:12
```

mohit: thanks. initial hypothesis: min_pool = 0 + new grace_period default -> we let requests trigger scale but warmup path is slow (kernel image pull + model kv load). Also auth 401s suggest token refresh flapping under load; combined causes retries and thundering herd.

jess: product note — ACME is on reserved capacity but with aggressive autoscale; they prefer not to bump committed instances without justification. We need a mitigation that doesn't require long-term commit.

mohit: short-term mitigations: 1) temporarily bump `min_instances` to 3 for `acme-dedicated-1` (manual warm pool) 2) enable priority warmup for their API key (pre-warm on billing window) 3) enable fallback routing to a smaller compatible model for tail latency spikes 4) rotate tokens to eliminate 401s. Example command: `rbctl pools update --name acme-dedicated-1 --min-instances 3`

alex: can we automate a one-off warmup instead of changing min permanently? maybe `rbctl pools warmup --name acme-dedicated-1 --instances 3 --hold 10m`

mohit: yes that works — I'll run a warmup now and stream logs. also kicking a quick token rotation for their key.

sophia: running warmup for 3 instances, pinging ACME that we're doing a temporary mitigation.

mohit: warmup logs look good, attach times now ~6–8s (image already pulled). after warm pool held, p99 back down to ~480ms on a synthetic burst. will monitor 10m. Created follow-up: Check orchestration backpressure heuristics and reduce grace_period mismatch (owner: mohit).

jess: ack. action items: (1) mohit — triage orchestrator grace_period/pull latency and propose fallback policy change (ETA 48h). (2) devex — add a playbook snippet for `rbctl warmup` for support (owner: sophia). (3) support — confirm with ACME once telemetry stable (owner: sophia).

sophia: I told ACME we're applying temporary warm pool + token rotation, will confirm after 10m monitoring window. thanks all :thumbsup:
